recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If DocumentReference attester/authenticator alignment needs further review, handle it under a separate DocumentReference Jira rather than reopening FHIR-15154.
issue_request: FHIR-15154 asked to add RelatedPerson as an allowed Composition.attester.party reference target for caregiver or representative attestation use cases. The resolution explicitly limited this ticket to Composition and suggested a separate ticket for any DocumentReference alignment.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentions FHIR-15154, but Jira comments say the work was already done. The same-change-family FHIR-12289 records svn revision 13104, which maps to git commit 04fb3079bd44513f51cffc189ec0828259a77715; that commit changed the historical Composition spreadsheet source for Composition.attester.party from Reference(Patient|Practitioner|PractitionerRole|Organization) to Reference(Patient|RelatedPerson|Practitioner|PractitionerRole|Organization).
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists composition=Composition as an active resource. The current source/composition/structuredefinition-Composition.xml targetProfile list for Composition.attester.party includes RelatedPerson. The originating Zulip thread matches the Jira request, and Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision. FHIR-12289 is the earlier same-change-family issue; FHIR-34160 is only background for the DocumentReference area that FHIR-15154 excluded.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active current Composition source already implements the requested RelatedPerson attester target and no source correction is needed. No DocumentReference edit was made because that was explicitly outside the seed resolution.
